scope: Freeze incoming-category factors and a Compendium-based melee MAX policy; not a fully calibrated live-game melee model

official.claim: Melee buildcrafting bonuses move to additive stacking; enhanced melee stat remains a separate base-damage multiplier. This alone does not verify every current Freeze interaction.
Describes the additive melee system and separate enhanced-stat multiplier.

conflicting_player_report.status: First-person game-issue report; not independently reproduced or treated as confirmed current behavior
conflicting_player_report.claim: Reports Frozen melee remaining multiplicative with other buffs and losing to the presence of One-Two Punch, rather than the simple shared additive maximum.

implementation.provider: victim; evaluate:on_hit; joins the same outgoing Profile as attacker contributions
implementation.primary: delta -0.05 PVE, -0.6 PVP; explicit weapon_damage and exactly one ammo category
implementation.special_or_heavy: delta +0.10; explicit weapon_damage and exactly one ammo category
implementation.light_ability: delta +0.05 with ability_damage and at least one arc/solar/void tag
implementation.basic_or_glaive: delta +1.20 for saved Freeze tiers Rank-and-File/Elite/Guardian, explicit melee_damage and exactly one basic_melee/glaive_melee category
implementation.melee_group: 1 + max(One-Two Punch delta, eligible Frozen delta) + other additive melee deltas; explicitly assumed policy from Compendium, not resolution of the current-game dispute
implementation.independent_factors: Frozen category factor multiplies melee group; target defense and native mitigation remain subsequent stages
implementation.sampling: Current target state at each impact, including captured attacks; no target contributions at capture
